description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for a simple calculator Android app. It manages UI components, user interactions, and calculator logic, including addition and subtraction operations, display updates, and input validation.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main entry point for the calculator app, handling UI initialization, user interactions, and calculation logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up UI components, and listeners.

methods.name: updateDisplay
methods.description: Updates the calculator display with optional animation.

methods.name: handleDigit
methods.description: Processes digit button presses, manages input validation and display updates.

methods.name: parseCurrentInput
methods.description: Parses current input string to Long, returns null if invalid.

methods.name: applyPendingOperator
methods.description: Applies the stored operator to the accumulator and current input.

methods.name: handleOperator
methods.description: Handles operator button presses, updates calculator state.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Performs calculation based on accumulator, pending operator, and current input, updating display.
